corpus.reason: FR-511: binding the experiment to a window that advances yearly would silently destroy observations as they age out

penalty.definition: comparator score minus transfer score on the primary metric; positive means the reset season cost the model performance
penalty.pairing_reason: the two arms are scored on different races (season R against season R-1), so a paired delta is undefined; bootstrap_delta refuses mismatched race sets rather than aligning them. Each arm is resampled independently within a replicate, which is wider than a paired interval and is the honest width.
penalty.interval_method: unpaired race bootstrap, 2000 replicates, each arm resampled independently within a replicate

edge_over_grid.definition: how much of the model's advantage over the grid was lost across the reset: (comparator model minus comparator grid) minus (transfer model minus transfer grid). Positive means the model transferred worse than the grid did. A season that was simply harder to predict cancels, because it hurt both predictors inside the same arm
edge_over_grid.pairing: paired within each arm, unpaired across them
